core_obligations: Reduction to the big case: the volume is computed after a modification mu : X~ -> X that makes K_V invertible; if K_V tensor F^{-1} is not big there is nothing to prove, so assume Vol(K_V tensor F^{-1}) > 0 and fix smooth hermitian metrics h_0 on T_X and h_F on F; they induce the smooth metric mu^*(det h_0^{-1} tensor h_F^{-1}) on mu^*(K_V tensor F^{-1}) (lines 1363-1368).

Fujita approximate Zariski decomposition: for every delta > 0 there is a modification mu_delta : X~_delta -> X dominating mu with mu_delta^*(K_V tensor F^{-1}) = O(A + E) where A, E are Q-divisors, A ample and E effective, and Vol(A) = A^n >= Vol(K_V tensor F^{-1}) - delta (lines 1368-1381).

Singular metric with log poles along E: a smooth metric h_A with positive definite curvature gives the singular hermitian metric h_A h_E on mu_delta^*(K_V tensor F) whose quotient by mu^*(det h_0^{-1} tensor h_F) is e^{-phi} with phi quasi-psh and logarithmic poles log|sigma_E|^2 modulo C-infinity along exactly E; then h = h_0 e^{(1/r)(mu_delta)^* phi} on T_X (the 1/r corrects the metric on det V) is admissible (lines 1382-1389).

Curvature current identity: for the resulting curvature current eta_F = Theta_{K_V, det h^*} - Theta_{F, h_F} one has mu_delta^* eta_F = Theta_{A,h_A} + [E], with [E] the current of integration on E (lines 1390-1392).

Morse integral conclusion: the 0-index Morse integral away from the poles equals int_{X(eta,0) setminus S} eta_F^n = int_{X~_delta} Theta_{A,h_A}^n = A^n >= Vol(K_V tensor F^{-1}) - delta, and since delta is arbitrary small the stated h^0 lower bound follows (line 1392-1393).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to Vol(K_V tensor F^{-1}) > 0 and fix the smooth background metrics.
Apply the Fujita approximate Zariski decomposition on a dominating modification.
Build the admissible singular metric with logarithmic poles along the effective divisor.
Identify the pullback curvature current and evaluate the 0-index Morse integral.
Let delta tend to zero to conclude the asymptotic h^0 bound.
difficulty_reason: 1362-1393以Fujita近似分解选取含log poles的奇异度量，用1/r校正det V后把曲率current拉回为Theta_A+[E]，将0-index Morse积分转成体积下界。度量与current的匹配不是直接把引用结论复述。
